evidence_quotes.O: If you're in the market for a NAS that gives you data redundancy (through RAID 1, that is, through data mirroring using two, user-replaceable hard drives)
evidence_quotes.C: I fitted the FireWire adapter to the drive and set to work backing up each of my 4 computers.
evidence_quotes.E: While using Skype, the sound I heard was very clear, like the person was sitting next to me. The other person reporting excellent sound, too
evidence_quotes.A: Western Digital's poorly received "SmartWare" has soured this product for a lot of customers. That's too bad, really, because the drive itself really isn't so bad.
evidence_quotes.N: I didn't encounter any serious issues, and the few minor installation bumps I encountered were easily remedied.
